label: No placebo
rationale: This is a non-randomized diagnostic study comparing ALS patients with age- and sex-matched healthy controls, not a placebo-controlled treatment trial. The listed interventions are diagnostic tests for both groups, including skin biopsy and autonomic testing, with no inactive or sham placebo comparator described.

evidence.quote: compare results from ALS patients with data obtained from a population

title: Longitudinal Assessment of Autonomic and Sensory Nervous System in ALS

rule.label: No placebo
